items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: he bought it from Sadie or his wife up there

ctx.x: Well, then, then, Herb Moran maybe had it right?

Well, Moran is the one, excuse me, Moran is the one that bought his cornet. Because when he came down here before he died, he told me that Fred is cornet, when Fred died, he bought it from Sadie or his wife up there. And he's been having it and playing down here with it. And he showed it to me. Of course, nevertheless, I was fooling cornet myself a little bit because Mal Perez would give me ideas and he'd give me a lesson. And also Hippolyte Shaw would give me lessons. But that was the music lessons only. And you…
Learn to soft edge and all that.
